content.value_statement: Genomic interval analysis needs consistent tokenization, embedding training, and quality checks across BED datasets. This skill guides Geniml workflows for Region2Vec, BEDspace, scEmbed, consensus peaks, and evaluation.
actual_capabilities: Select appropriate Geniml methods for genomic interval machine learning tasks.
Plan Region2Vec tokenization, training, and evaluation steps for BED collections.
Guide BEDspace preprocessing, training, distance calculation, and cross-modal searches.
Outline scEmbed preparation, training, embedding export, and scanpy integration.
Compare CC, CCF, ML, and HMM approaches for consensus peak universes.
Reference BBClient, BEDshift, tokenization, evaluation, and Text2BedNN utilities.
limitations: Does not run Geniml, install dependencies, or validate local data without separate tool use.
Requires correctly formatted BED files, metadata, universe files, and genome assembly choices.
Large scATAC-seq or HMM workflows may require substantial memory and compute resources.
Scientific conclusions still require domain review and independent validation.

use_cases.title: Plan Region Embedding Studies
use_cases.description: Choose a Region2Vec workflow for bulk genomic BED collections and define tokenization, training, and evaluation steps.

use_cases.title: Analyze Single-Cell Accessibility
use_cases.description: Prepare scEmbed workflows for scATAC-seq data, including tokenization, model training, clustering, and scanpy integration.

use_cases.title: Build Searchable Genomic Collections
use_cases.description: Use BEDspace and Text2BedNN concepts to connect region sets, metadata labels, and similarity search workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: A new user has BED files and needs a method recommendation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best Geniml workflow for my BED files. Compare Region2Vec, BEDspace, scEmbed, and consensus peak building.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Region2Vec Training
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a structured embedding plan for bulk genomic intervals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Region2Vec plan for BED files, including universe selection, tokenization checks, training parameters, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design scEmbed Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: A single-cell project needs an embedding and clustering workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scEmbed workflow for an scATAC-seq AnnData object. Include pre-tokenization, model training, embedding export, clustering, and validation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Universe Methods
prompt_templates.scenario: A project needs a consensus peak strategy with method tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare CC, CCF, ML, and HMM consensus peak methods for my project. Recommend parameters for assay type, peak width, and compute limits.

output_examples.input: I have 200 ATAC-seq BED files and no labels.
output_examples.output: A Region2Vec plan with universe preparation, hard tokenization, coverage checks, training settings, and embedding evaluation steps.

output_examples.input: I have scATAC-seq data in AnnData and want clusters.
output_examples.output: A scEmbed workflow covering peak coordinates, tokenized cells, model training, embedding storage in AnnData, neighbors, Leiden, and UMAP.

output_examples.input: I need a shared search space for regions and tissue labels.
output_examples.output: A BEDspace plan with preprocessing, metadata formatting, training, distance calculation, query type selection, and result interpretation.

best_practices: Build and validate a high-quality universe before training embeddings.
Record parameters, random seeds, genome assembly, and software versions for reproducibility.
Evaluate embeddings with quantitative metrics and biological labels when available.
anti_patterns: Do not train embeddings before checking tokenization coverage.
Do not mix genome assemblies within one universe or model.
Do not treat similarity search results as validated biological findings.

faq.question: What data does this skill work with?
faq.answer: It supports BED file collections, chromatin accessibility data, metadata labels, and scATAC-seq workflows.

faq.question: Can it help choose between Region2Vec and BEDspace?
faq.answer: Yes. Use Region2Vec for unsupervised region embeddings, and BEDspace when metadata labels should share the embedding space.

faq.question: Does it replace Geniml documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes practical workflows and points to method choices, but detailed parameters still come from Geniml documentation.

faq.question: Can it create a consensus peak universe?
faq.answer: It can guide CC, CCF, ML, and HMM universe building steps, including parameter selection and quality checks.

faq.question: Does it handle single-cell ATAC-seq?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines scEmbed preparation, tokenization, training, embedding generation, and scanpy integration.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: Geniml is required, and some workflows also need ML libraries, scanpy, gtars, uniwig, or StarSpace.
